newsitem.title: ITALY: Minimum rate 7.45 pct at Italy lira repo tender.
newsitem.headline: Minimum rate 7.45 pct at Italy lira repo tender.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's 6.5 trillion lire 15-day Bank of Italy repurchase tender was 7.45 percent, compared with 7.41 percent at the previous repo tender on March 12, the Bank said.
The average rate was also 7.45 percent against 7.42 percent at the last repurchase pact for 8.5 trillion lire and five days.
The pact covers purchases today and the securities are for resale on April 1. The Bank said it received 43 bids of which three were met in full and six in part.
